name: Crispy Chicken Burger
description: Golden crispy chicken layered with melted cheese and fresh lettuce. Served with creamy mayo and a soft toasted bun. Perfect for crunchy and juicy burger lovers.

name: Chicken Burger
description: Juicy chicken fillet packed with fresh vegetables and signature sauce. Soft bun with a smoky grilled flavor. A simple yet satisfying meal for any time.

name: Chicken Cheese Burger
description: Loaded with extra cheese and a flavorful chicken patty. Every bite delivers creamy and savory goodness. A must-try for cheese lovers.

name: BBQ Chicken Burger
description: Smoky BBQ chicken combined with fresh veggies and rich sauce. Grilled to perfection for a bold taste experience. Served in a warm toasted bun.

name: Veggie Burger
description: Healthy veggie patty made with fresh garden vegetables and herbs. Light, tasty, and full of flavor. Ideal for vegetarian food lovers.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic pizza topped with mozzarella cheese and tomato sauce. Baked with a crispy crust and rich flavor. Simple, fresh, and delicious.

name: Chicken Pepperoni Pizza
description: Loaded with spicy chicken pepperoni and stretchy cheese. Freshly baked for a smoky and savory taste. Perfect for pizza lovers who enjoy bold flavors.

name: Chicken Supreme Pizza
description: Topped with chicken, vegetables, and premium cheese blend. Crispy crust with rich and creamy toppings. A complete pizza feast for sharing.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
description: Smoky BBQ sauce paired with grilled chicken chunks and cheese. Freshly baked with flavorful toppings. A perfect mix of sweet and savory taste.

name: Veggie Delight Pizza
description: Colorful vegetables layered over melted cheese and soft crust. Fresh, healthy, and satisfying. A delightful choice for veggie pizza fans.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-layer sandwich filled with chicken, egg, and fresh vegetables. Crispy toasted bread adds extra crunch. Perfect for a filling snack or lunch.

name: Chicken Sandwich
description: Tender grilled chicken served with fresh lettuce and creamy sauce. Soft bread with balanced flavors. A light yet tasty sandwich option.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Crispy toasted bread stuffed with melted cheese. Warm, creamy, and comforting in every bite. Best enjoyed hot and fresh.

name: Tuna Sandwich
description: Fresh tuna mixed with mayo and crunchy vegetables. Light and flavorful with a creamy texture. Great for seafood lovers.

name: Veg Sandwich
description: Fresh vegetables and chutney layered inside soft bread slices. Healthy, refreshing, and full of natural flavors. A simple vegetarian delight.

name: Raw Mango Juice
description: Fresh raw mango blended into a sweet and creamy drink. Chilled perfectly for hot summer days. Rich in refreshing tropical flavor.

name: Pineapple Juice
description: Refreshing pineapple juice with a naturally sweet taste. Made from fresh ripe pineapples. A cool and fruity energy booster.

name: Orange Juice
description: Freshly squeezed oranges blended into a natural juice. Rich in vitamin C and refreshing flavor. Perfect for a healthy drink option.

name: Lemon Juice
description: Refreshing lemon juice mixed with mint and chilled ice. Light, tangy, and cooling for summer. A perfect thirst quencher.

name: Dragon Juice
description: Exotic dragon fruit juice with a vibrant color and fresh taste. Naturally sweet and refreshing. A unique tropical drink experience.

name: Watermelon Juice
description: Fresh watermelon blended into a cool and juicy drink. Extremely refreshing and hydrating for summer days. Sweet natural flavor in every sip.
